subject: Reschedule: Oakridge systems demo — wait for FY spend freeze to lift
messages:
From: Emma Richards <emma.richards@oakridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo request — RFC & procurement timing

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the overview last week. Our engineering and procurement teams are ready to see a short 45-minute demo focused on latency/cost tradeoffs for inference. Can we lock something for the week of Jul 26? Preferably Jul 28 in the morning (Oakridge time). Procurement also asked for a copy of the RFQ and any standard SOW templates before the demo — I attached our short requirements doc (see filename below).

High-level ask: demo + 15 min procurement sync afterwards.

People: Me (EM), our procurement alias procurement@oakridge.com, and my manager Aaron Patel (cc included on follow-ups).

Attachments: Oakridge-requirements-brief.pdf (attached)

Best,
Emma
Emma Richards
Head of Platform Partnerships
Oakridge Systems

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Richards <emma.richards@oakridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — RFC & procurement timing

Hi Emma — thanks for sending this over and for the clear scope. Karthik (AE) and I can run the demo; Lauren (engineering lead) is looped for any deeper infra questions.

We currently have availability Jul 28 at 10:00 AM Oakridge (PDT) and Jul 30 at 9:00 AM. I know procurement will want the docs in advance — attaching a couple of templates we usually share (SOW + PoC checklist).

Attachments: Oakridge-SOW-template.docx, Redwood-PoC-checklist.pdf

If neither slot works, happy to propose alternatives.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: internal: FY spend freeze + travel conflict — advise on scheduling

Internal note — do NOT confirm Jul 28 yet. Finance announced a temporary FY spend freeze that covers Oakridge until their CFO signs off; effective Jul 25 through mid-August while they complete the FY reset. Separately, I'm on site for a partner deep dive the week of Jul 26 and won't be available to jump on a last-minute technical call.

Recommend we: 1) ask Emma if they can move the live demo to the week of Aug 16+ (post budget lock), and 2) offer a short technical drop-in (20 min) the week of Jul 26 that Karthik or I can do asynchronously or as an office hours session to keep momentum. Procurement will likely need the RFQ/SOW for review — make sure legal has the SOW template ready but do not push pricing until we confirm their budget window.

I'll be happy to join the Aug slot once my travel wraps.

— Lauren
Director, Solution Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Richards <emma.richards@oakridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@oakridge.com
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 11:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — RFC & procurement timing

Hi Emma — quick update after chatting with our solutions team. Two constraints to highlight:

- Oakridge mentioned a FY spend freeze window that starts around Jul 25; we don’t want to present pricing until that locks.
- Our engineering lead (Lauren) is traveling the week of Jul 26 and cannot join Jul 28.

Given that, would Oakridge be open to shifting the full 45-minute demo + procurement sync to the week of Aug 16 (we have openings Aug 17 and Aug 19 morning PT)? If you need something sooner to keep internal momentum, Karthik can run a 20-minute technical office-hours session the week of Jul 26 (no pricing, just architecture and integration Q&A).

I attached the SOW and PoC checklist we shared internally — feel free to pass these to procurement. If Aug 17/19 works for you, we can lock time and have legal standing by with a draft SOW (no negotiated pricing until your budget re-opens).

Attachments: Oakridge-SOW-template.docx, Redwood-PoC-checklist.pdf

Thanks — let me know which option you prefer.

Best,
Marissa

From: Emma Richards <emma.richards@oakridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@oakridge.com
Date: Sat, 24 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — RFC & procurement timing

Marissa — thanks for the signal and for the flexible options. We need to respect the internal FY lock here, so Aug 19 at 10:00 AM PT works well for us (we'll slot Aaron and procurement). Please send a calendar invite and include a short agenda: demo (30), procurement Q&A (15).

I've attached an updated RFQ for your review and a sample PO format procurement prefers. Also please intro someone from legal/ops who can handle SOW review and next steps for contracting / DocuSign once budget is confirmed.

Attachments: Oakridge-PoC-RFQ.pdf, Oakridge-PO-format.pdf

See you Aug 19 — and appreciate the office-hours offer; if we have pre-demo technical questions we'll reach out to Karthik.

— Emma
